# DesignManufacturingGap

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The disconnect between AI-driven materials design speed and traditional fabrication capabilities, where theoretical predictions cannot be rapidly translated into physical devices. Identifies the critical bottleneck in TCC hardware realization, motivating research into in-network or topology-aware manufacturing methods.
